remarks: Perched high in the iconic Hollywood Riviera, this newly remodeled single-level, 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offers an exquisite blend of high-end design, warm contemporary finishes, and breathtaking panoramic views. A long, private driveway leads to a sleek custom wood front door, welcoming you into an expansive, light-filled open layout anchored by wide-plank white oak flooring, Milgard windows, and a custom wood-slat mudroom drop zone with built-in storage. The impressive grand living area features soaring vaulted A-frame ceilings and a stunning floor-to-ceiling wall of glass with bi-folding glass doors opening seamlessly to the backyard, creating the ultimate indoor-outdoor setting
